headline: Growth Marketing Manager | MENA Digital Demand & Full-Funnel Optimization
summary: Growth Marketing Manager with specialized expertise in financial markets, Forex, and Crypto, driving scalable demand generation across MENA, EU, and Asian regions. Proven track record in owning the full digital funnel from awareness to revenue, leveraging data-driven strategies to optimize ROAS and conversion rates. Skilled in managing high-performance media buying on Google and Meta, executing ABM campaigns, and building robust marketing automation systems. Bilingual (Arabic/English) professional with deep cultural insight into the MENA market, capable of localizing global strategies to support commercial outcomes in scale-up environments.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Owned the end-to-end digital demand engine, managing full-funnel KPIs including ROAS, conversion optimization, and lead generation across MENA, EU, and Asian markets.
Executed multi-channel growth campaigns aligned with revenue targets, driving qualified pipeline and improving deal velocity through strategic partnership with sales teams.
Managed media buying across Google and Meta ads, optimizing ad budgets and targeting to maximize ROI in competitive financial and fintech sectors.
Developed data-driven marketing strategies by analyzing funnel performance and attribution models to identify high-impact growth levers.
Led strategic marketing supervision for major Telegram financial platforms, enhancing user engagement and community growth through localized content and campaigns.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Supported user growth and engagement across multiple geographies, focusing on the Arabic crypto ecosystem and MENA market expansion.
Executed AMA campaigns and KOL relations to generate brand awareness and drive community participation, directly contributing to user acquisition goals.
Collaborated with regional teams to localize growth strategies, ensuring brand consistency while adapting to cultural nuances in the MENA region.
Utilized server-side tracking and analytics integration to provide clear dashboards on funnel performance and campaign ROI.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer & Creative Strategist
bullets: Engineered automated marketing tools and server-side tracking systems to enhance data accuracy and streamline marketing operations.
Built robust backends and web applications to support digital agency services, demonstrating strong technical understanding of marketing infrastructure.
Integrated AI solutions and automated workflows to improve operational efficiency and support scalable growth initiatives.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Growth Marketing Manager role at AMAN. With a background in driving demand generation for financial and crypto platforms across MENA, I have successfully owned full-funnel KPIs from awareness to revenue. My experience in media buying, ABM, and data-driven campaign optimization aligns perfectly with AMAN's mission to build a scalable, performance-led marketing function. I am eager to leverage my bilingual capabilities and deep understanding of MENA buyer behavior to support your global growth objectives and contribute to reducing financial crime impact.

screening.q: Do you have proven experience in Growth Marketing / Demand Generation roles?
Do you have experience operating across regions, specifically with MENA experience?
Do you have deep hands-on experience with HubSpot and funnel analytics?
Do you have Arabic language skills?
Are you comfortable in a scale-up environment?
